description_full: CTF Services Limited is a conglomerate company with a diversified portfolio of businesses in financial services, toll roads, logistics, construction, and facilities management primarily in Hong Kong and the Chinese Mainland. It offers insurance, investment banking, securities trading, financial planning, and asset management services, including life insurance, medical insurance, critical illness insurance, personal accident insurance, saving insurance plans, annuities, investment-linked assurance schemes, group medical insurance, group life insurance, MPF and general insurance; online securities brokerage, fintech solutions in securities trading, and wealth management; and wealth structuring and legacy planning services. The company also engages in investing and managing logistic projects; construction services to residential, commercial, governmental, and institutional sectors; and operating, management, and operation of Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, Gleneagles Hospital Hong Kong, and Kai Tak Sports Park. In addition, it is involved in the operation of toll roads and logistics property; building construction; property investment, agency, and management and consultancy services; civil engineering; financing; piling, ground investigation, and civil engineering; financial, bond issuing, and catering services; and carpark, commercial complex, and hotel management services. Further, the company provides foundation works; Battery energy storage system; medical and healthcare outpatient services; owns, develops, and manages private hospital; produces and sells ready-mixed concrete; operates a quarry mill; trades in aggregates and stonefines; and leases and manages commercial aircraft. The company was formerly known as Pacific Ports Co Limited and changed its name to NWS Holdings Limited in January 2003. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong. The company is a subsidiary of Century Acquisition Limited.
